title: WePM: Hierarchical Conflict Reconciliation for Unified MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.27365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bringing multimodal intelligence from the cloud to users' devices keeps sensitive data local and reduces inference cost, but deploying a specialized model per capability duplicates vision-language capacity under tight memory and compute budgets. We formalize heterogeneous capability density (HCD), measuring how broadly and effectively a model serves heterogeneous task families per unit of resident inference memory. High HCD across representation, generation, and decision raises two challenges: these capabilities need visual evidence at different spatial granularities under a fixed token budget, and separately collected task corpora yield conflicting updates to shared parameters, while cross-task paired supervision is costly and ambiguous for open-ended inputs. We present WePM, a family of pocket models unifying representation, generation, and decision within one vision-language backbone. Multi-Granularity Visual Budgeting (MGVB) allocate

translated_title: WePM：面向统一多模态大模型的分层冲突调和
translated_abstract: 将多模态智能从云端迁移至用户设备，可将敏感数据保留在本地并降低推理成本，但在内存与计算预算紧张的情况下，为每种能力部署专门的模型会重复占用视觉-语言容量。我们形式化了异构能力密度（HCD），用于衡量模型在每单位常驻推理内存下服务异构任务族的广度与有效性。要在表示、生成和决策三类能力上实现高HCD，面临两大挑战：其一，在固定token预算下，这些能力需要不同空间粒度的视觉证据；其二，分别收集的任务语料会对共享参数产生冲突的更新，而跨任务配对监督对于开放式输入而言成本高昂且语义模糊。我们提出WePM，这是一个在单一视觉-语言骨干中统一表示、生成和决策的口袋模型系列。多粒度视觉预算分配（MGVB）……
tldr: WePM通过形式化异构能力密度（HCD）、多粒度视觉预算分配和分层冲突调和，在单一视觉-语言骨干中统一了表示、生成与决策能力，打造出适用于端侧部署的口袋模型系列。
en_tdlr: WePM unifies representation, generation, and decision capabilities within a single vision-language backbone for on-device deployment, by formalizing heterogeneous capability density, employing Multi-Granularity Visual Budgeting, and hierarchically reconciling conflicting cross-task parameter updates.
